structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. I understood that a deposit locks the money for a fixed period at an interest rate, with 15% tax on the interest and a fine from the bank if you break it early (the site doesn't say how much). In their example I'd end up with less than I put in because of rising prices, and they say there's no deposit insurance in Israel, so I'll ask my son and the bank before doing anything.
